P2V helps young athletes build basketball skills, confidence, and character in a supportive training community.

WILL TURNER / FOUNDER & HEAD TRAINER

MEET COACH WILL

A Madison coach.
A lasting impact.

Will Turner founded Path 2 Victory Basketball Academy to help young athletes grow through basketball. He has spent years training players in Madison and across Dane County.

Alongside his son Tre Turner, Will helps athletes develop their basketball skills, strength, speed, mental toughness, and character.

WHAT WE BELIEVE

More than a game.
A way to grow.

Skills, character, education, and life are the four pillars of P2V. Together, they shape an approach to development that reaches beyond the scoreboard.

01 / SKILLS

Build your foundation.

Develop your basketball skills and athletic ability through focused coaching and consistent practice.

02 / CHARACTER

Show up with purpose.

Bring effort, take responsibility, and support the people working alongside you.

03 / EDUCATION

Keep learning.

Stay curious, listen to feedback, and use each challenge as an opportunity to grow.

04 / LIFE

Carry it forward.

Take the confidence, resilience, and teamwork you develop into life beyond basketball.
